posts.name: ContextOS
posts.tagline: Save tokens and money on your AI agents
posts.description: ContextOS helps you find and reduce wasted AI agent tokens. The free Auditor shows usage, estimated costs, and savings opportunities. The Optimiser reduces supported tool waste. Keep your agent and model. Local-first, with a 90-day Optimiser trial.

posts.name: FindEvo
posts.tagline: Find them on Reddit. Reach out without getting banned.
posts.description: FindEvo finds people on Reddit who actually need your product. It scores posts by buying intent, so you skip hours of scrolling. Most founders post in the wrong subreddit and get banned. FindEvo finds the right subreddits, scores the posts, and shows you how to approach each lead. Not a copy-paste message, but a real approach tailored to them.

posts.name: Reflow
posts.tagline: Convert, split, and edit PDFs into clean EPUBs privately.
posts.description: Turn PDFs into perfectly structured EPUBs locally in your browser. Built by a writer to preserve chapters, headings, and images. Split, merge, and rename sections with zero server uploads. 100% private, free, and secure ebook creation.

posts.name: Snowballer
posts.tagline: See the month you're debt-free — then get there faster
posts.description: Snowballer turns your debts into one payoff plan and puts the debt-free date on the scoreboard. Add balances, pick snowball or avalanche, log payments, and watch the date move. Try what-if extras before you commit. Payoff math is free; bank sync is optional Plus.

posts.name: Meet Lula
posts.tagline: Get your brand cited where customers and AI look
posts.description: Lula is an AI digital PR agent that finds relevant journalist requests, media openings and authority gaps, develops credible angles and carries out outreach and submissions within your rules. Then it shows you what turned into coverage, backlinks, brand mentions, citations and traffic.

posts.name: Spro
posts.tagline: Use Any AI Model Through One Unified Gateway
posts.description: SPRO is a unified AI gateway and security platform. Access OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure, and more through one OpenAI-compatible API, with smart routing, automatic failover, and caching built in. Layered on top: real security guardrails prompt injection detection, PII/PHI/PFI masking, jailbreak protection, and output validation. Add full observability, cost controls, and BYOK one control layer for accessing, securing, and governing every AI model your team uses, at true enterprise scale.

posts.name: Echo Money
posts.tagline: Instant Cross-Border Payments Across 110+ Countries
posts.description: Echo Money is an end-to-end global cross-border payments platform that helps businesses collect, convert, send, and settle money across 110+ countries, 70+ currencies, and 215+ local payment methods. Built to make international payments feel as simple as local transfers, Echo Money gives businesses a single API and dashboard to manage global collections, payouts, accounts, FX, treasury and stablecoin payments.

posts.name: Insight O' Mate
posts.tagline: Your AI Analyst for NoSQL Databases
posts.description: Insight-O-Mate is your AI data analyst for NoSQL databases. Ask questions in plain English and get answers, insights, and database queries without writing them yourself. Built for founders, PMs, developers, and teams working with MongoDB, Firestore, Redis, and DynamoDB. Connect your database, ask your question, and let Insight-O-Mate handle the analysis.

posts.name: Hotelia.io
posts.tagline: Earn more on every direct booking. Keep 100%.
posts.description: Hotelia is the all-in-one platform for independent hotels, right on your own website. Guests book direct, you keep 100% of every booking, and there's zero commission. Revenue Builder adds the small touches guests love, so every stay earns more. It runs the day for you too: bookings, payments, housekeeping, and guest emails, all in one place. Your website, your guests, your brand.

posts.name: PikaEdit
posts.tagline: 30+ free online tools. No uploads, no signup, no limits
posts.description: PikaEdit is a free, privacy-focused online tool platform. Your files never leave your device — all processing happens in your browser. - PDF Tools: Merge, split, compress, edit, Word/Excel/PPT to PDF - Image Tools: Compress, resize, convert, crop, AI background removal - Developer Tools: JSON editor, QR code, Mermaid diagrams, Hash, Regex - Text Tools: Word counter, case converter, diff checker - CV Builder with ATS scoring - Encrypted note sharing (zero-knowledge, AES-256)

posts.name: LeadGuard AI
posts.tagline: Stop losing WhatsApp sales. AI recovers ghosted leads.
posts.description: LeadGuard AI recovers ghosted WhatsApp leads. Never lose a sale again. FEATURES: Recovery Score 78% (AI ranks who will buy NOW), AI Message Suggestions (3 variations: friendly/urgency/scarcity personalized), 1-Click WhatsApp, Smart Kanban (New/Negotiating/At Risk/Recovered/Closed + Hot/Warm/Cold/Ghosted tags), Lost Sales Dashboard (money left, ghosted count, ROI), Auto Reminders (24h alert + daily list), Lifetime $37 no monthly fees.

posts.name: Litora
posts.tagline: Curated digital bookstore for indie authors & bookshops
posts.description: Litora is an independent digital marketplace designed to bridge the gap between indie authors, boutique creators, and digital readers. We handle hosting, distribution, and instant delivery offering up to 55% margins for bookshop creators and up to 30% royalties for authors with zero upfront setup fees.

posts.name: Craftfolio — portfolios & resumes
posts.tagline: Build. Showcase. Get noticed.
posts.description: I’m 16 and I built Craftfolio as a project to challenge myself and make something I’d actually want to use. It lets you create a portfolio and resume in one place and customize it to your style. I’m putting it out here mainly to get honest feedback, so give it a try and tell me what you think. I’d really appreciate it! 🚀

posts.name: Feed Title Optimizer
posts.tagline: Rewrite Shopping titles without touching your Shopify PDP
posts.description: Shopify sync overwrites the titles you fix in Merchant Center. Feed Title Optimizer rewrites Shopping titles into a CSV ready for supplemental feed — free audit of 10 titles, then a $49 pack up to 500 SKU.

posts.name: ClearScroll
posts.tagline: Block annoying cookie banners & login walls instantly.
posts.description: Block annoying cookie popups, newsletter modals, and login walls to scroll the web freely. ClearScroll is a lightweight, privacy-first browser extension that removes intrusive cookie consents, newsletter popups, and forced login walls (like Pinterest & Medium) so you can browse the web in peace. No tracking, 100% local processing.

posts.name: Quickshares.online
posts.tagline: Send files. Like magic.
posts.description: Quickshares.online is a free, fast, and magical temporary file transfer service. Share files instantly across devices using a simple PIN and OTP.

posts.name: OpenTrustBench
posts.tagline: A trust score for every AI agent
posts.description: OpenTrustBench is a free, local-first security scanner for AI agents and MCP servers. 8 OWASP-mapped rules, Trust Cards graded A–F, SARIF output, and a public registry of 53 scanned servers.

posts.name: JSON Semantic Diff
posts.tagline: Compare JSON by meaning, not just position.
posts.description: Built for messy JSON with reordered arrays. JSON Semantic Diff infers likely object identity, supports composite keys and manual overrides, and suppresses positional noise so meaningful changes stand out. Everything runs locally in the browser.

posts.name: Event Horizon Data
posts.tagline: The data stack you don't have to build
posts.description: Ingestion, warehouse and dashboards in one place. Pull scattered sources together, model them once, and give every client their own view, with your brand on it.

posts.name: GradeMate
posts.tagline: Pre-grade your cards with AI
posts.description: Pre-grade your cards before sending them to gradation companies. GradeMate scores centering, corners, edges and surface on both faces of your card, against the criteria PSA, BGS, CGC and SGC publish — and gives you the grade to expect before you pay for a submission.

posts.name: Lucidra
posts.tagline: API traffic, tests and Git in one local-first workspace
posts.description: Lucidra is a local-first API engineering workspace for Linux, macOS and Windows. Build and send HTTP, GraphQL, WebSocket, Socket.IO, gRPC and SSE requests. Receive webhooks, tunnel public traffic to localhost and inspect email. Trace HTTP/HTTPS, match captures to saved requests and review differences. Turn real flows into suites, async scenarios and regressions; add mocks, contracts, Docs, visual Git and permissioned MCP for AI agents. Personal workspaces are free and need no account.

posts.name: 一页人间
posts.tagline: product images, old photo restoration, doodle to art
posts.description: 一页人间 · 电商配图、详情页、文生图、图生图、去水印、老照片修复、涂鸦转画、视频与音频，10 个工具一站搞定。注册送 50 积分，低至 ¥0.1/张，先试再充。本站图片为 AI 生成。

posts.name: Kodavara DataFlow
posts.tagline: Turn ClickUp data into clean, automated, usable exports.
posts.description: Kodavara DataFlow transforms ClickUp data into customized, ready-to-use exports. Select and rename fields, join related datasets, create calculated values, standardize formatting, and automate recurring delivery—without maintaining code or paying for a custom integration.

posts.name: Sharp Stock
posts.tagline: A local-first asset manager built for game developers
posts.description: Preview, search, organize, and process game assets without moving your library to the cloud. Sharp Stock supports 3D models, Spine, images, audio, fonts, local AI visual search and background removal, plus atlas and sprite tools.

posts.name: Bluff
posts.tagline: Call the bluff. Play cards with friends or bots.
posts.description: A free browser card game for 3–6 seats. Play face-down cards, challenge a bluff, and try to empty your hand. Practice with three bot difficulties or invite friends to a private room. Guided lessons included. No account or download needed.

posts.name: Shrink: Photo Compressor
posts.tagline: Shrink: Compress, Save, Share
posts.description: Shrink: Photo Compressor is the ultimate photo compressor. Set an exact maximum size, not a vague quality percentage. Compress up to 20 photos in one batch. Before and after sizes shown for every result. Start straight from the Photos share sheet, without opening the app. Save to a dedicated Shrink album, or share anywhere. Photos already under your target are left untouched, so nothing is degraded for no reason. Accepts JPEG, HEIC and PNG; compressed results are saved as JPEG.

posts.name: LiftLegends
posts.tagline: Your workout evolves a pet. Then you battle friends.
posts.description: LiftLegends turns workouts into an RPG. Every exercise powers up your pet. Every gym session unlocks evolutions. Then you battle other players using your real fitness stats. What makes it different: - Your pet's strength = your actual workout effort (not fake progress) - AI generates personalized workout plans in seconds - Real-time PvP battles against friends worldwide - 70+ creatures across 5 evolution stages Built for people who hate working out but love games.

posts.name: Sportra
posts.tagline: Live football scores, fixtures, stats, and match insights
posts.description: Live football scores, fixtures, standings, top scorers, xG stats, and match insights — updated in real time across Sportra.

posts.name: UseSQLite
posts.tagline: Hosted SQLite with backups, branching, search, and an SDK
posts.description: UseSQLite gives developers a managed home for SQLite databases without giving up the simplicity of SQLite files. Create or import a database, browse and edit tables, run SQL, add indexed full-text search, generate typed SDK definitions, issue read-only or read-write API keys, create backups, restore versions, and fork databases for safe experiments. The JavaScript and React SDK fits into existing apps. Unlimited databases with 3 GB of storage for $5 per month.
